[+] Player Hitbox (HBE): This new feature for manipulating player hitboxes has been added.
[+] Tackle Hitbox (HBE): This new feature for manipulating tackle hitboxes has been added.
[+] Slider Player Hitbox (XYZ): A new slider has been added to give you precise control over your player's hitbox dimensions (X, Y, and Z).
[+] Slider Tackle Hitbox (XYZ): A new slider has been added to give you precise control over your tackle's hitbox dimensions (X, Y, and Z).
[+] Inf Stamina: This feature has been added with three different methods. If one method fails, it will automatically try the next one.

[+] Select Team: This new feature has been added, allowing you to choose your team.
[+] Select Positions: This new feature has been added, allowing you to choose your position on the team.
[+] Auto Join Selected Team & Positions: This feature has been added to automatically join your selected team and position.
[+] Select Pack: This new feature has been added, allowing you to choose which packs to buy.
[+] Auto Buy Selected Pack: This feature has been added to automatically purchase your selected packs.

[+] Anti-AFK: This feature has been added.
[+] Auto Rejoin: This feature has been added to automatically rejoin the game if you get disconnected, kicked, or encounter any type of error message.
[+] Select Boost Speed: This feature has been added, allowing you to select a boost speed. (Note: It currently has some bugs.)
[+] Enable Boost Speed: This feature has been added to enable your selected boost speed. (Note: It currently has some bugs.)
